saudi_hunt_notes: Searched Riyadh (barbers, gyms, bakeries, auto detailing), Jeddah (salons, florists), Dammam/Khobar (restaurants, cafes), Makkah/Madinah (restaurants), Taif (restaurants). Saudi businesses overwhelmingly publish phone/WhatsApp/Instagram only. Near-misses: LEGENDARY CUTS Riyadh (5.0, 460 reviews, no email found); Velvet Rose Beauty Lounge Jeddah (4.8, 400 reviews, no email found); TOP LEVEL Riyadh (email toplevel1@gmail.com published, but ALREADY demoed and already emailed, excluded by report-data.json); all Jeddah florists with published emails (Sepale, Little Flora, Joi, Misk, Florinta) HAVE their own websites, disqualified. Bohoo was the one qualifying Saudi lead found: no website, published email, 5,055 reviews.
